headline: 82% of Businesses Turn to Commercial Loans, Reports Querétaro Chamber of Commerce
summary: The Querétaro Chamber of Commerce reported that 82 percent of businesses rely on commercial loans. It signed financing alliances with Nafin and Banco Afirme to fund service-sector companies.
why: Commercial credit access shapes how small and mid-sized firms invest and grow, and it matters for regional bank lending. Development banks such as Nafin support lending to businesses in Mexico.
original_headline: El 82% de los negocios recurren a préstamo comercial, reporta Cámara de Comercio de Querétaro
